delivery.en: Official parcel notices come via the Bermuda Post Office, not a WhatsApp duty demand
delivery.zh: 正式包裹通知走百慕達郵政；WhatsApp 要你付關稅的不是投遞通知

readback.en: After 441, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero; Bermuda dollars; 12-hour time; day before month
readback.zh: 441 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；百慕達元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A WhatsApp or text claiming the Bermuda Post Office needs customs duties through a link is a scam
fraud.zh: WhatsApp 或簡訊自稱百慕達郵政，要你點連結付關稅，都是詐騙

habits.en: Quite formal: Good afternoon with strangers. British-leaning English. Money is in Bermuda dollars, not US dollars.
habits.zh: 相當正式，對不熟的人說 Good afternoon。英語偏英式。貨幣是百慕達元，不是美元。

stall_local.en: The bank sign-in will not finish, and a parcel can only be confirmed at the Bermuda Post Office.
stall_local.zh: 卡在銀行登入一直完不成，而且包裹只能透過百慕達郵政正式管道確認。

reason.zh: 美國門廊交件；百慕達官方包裹通知是走郵政管道，不是門廊櫃
美國轉帳品牌，不是百慕達銀行的慣用說法
美國聯邦健保，不宜套進百慕達電話
美式郵遞區號；當地較常說地址或郵政局

talk_style_diff.en: Sit up a register from casual US English. Titles and Good afternoon come more naturally. Speak of Bermuda dollars and the Bermuda Post Office, not IRS refunds or porch lockers.
talk_style_diff.zh: 比隨興的美國英語再正經一檔。頭銜與 Good afternoon 更自然。說百慕達元和百慕達郵政，不要講 IRS 退稅或門廊包裹櫃。

uncertain: 包裹是送到府還是多半到郵局領，官方防詐文沒有細寫投遞比例。
日期口頭順序是依百慕達偏英式習慣推得，不是電信規範。
